title: Netflix’s Biggest Anime of The Year Is All Set For a New Release
content: 2026 was off to an exciting start after Netflix globally released a stunning sci-fi anime film, Cosmic Princess Kaguya. The film immediately became a massive hit on the platform and crossed over a million views globally in just three days after its release.
author: ComicBook

title: CyberAgent Establishes Canvas Kyoto Creative Hub
content: Canvas Kyoto is implementing a paid training program for young creators who aspire to work in anime and game production. The company will help teach practical skills to the new creators.
author: ANN

title: Demon Slayer Studio Unveils New Update on Upcoming Fantasy Film
content: Established in 2000, the animation studio Ufotable climbed through the ranks to become one of the most successful studios in the industry. Ever since its establishment, the studio has been behind several unique anime series and films, including the Fate/Zero franchise and The Garden of Sinners.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll’s Biggest Action Fantasy of The Year Creator Hypes The Best Arc
content: Based on Fujino Omori’s acclaimed light novel, Wistoria: Wand and Sword is one of the biggest action fantasy series in recent years. Omori is renowned for the acclaimed series Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon?
author: ComicBook

title: Finn & Jake Reunite in New Adventure Time Revival (Release Date & First Look Revealed)
content: Adventure Time is coming back to screens five years after its previous entry came to an end, and has confirmed the release date for its new Finn and Jake starring spinoff with its first look.
author: ComicBook

title: 'Wasted Chef' Movie Unveils Teaser Visual
content: The Annecy Animation Showcase presentation at the 79th Cannes International Film Festival revealed a teaser visual for director Takayuki Hirao 's original anime project, titled Wasted Chef .
author: MyAnimeList

title: Crunchyroll Confirms a New Jujutsu Kaisen Collab & Reveals New Summer Look Ahead of Season 4
content: Gege Akutami’s beloved Jujutsu Kaisen manga reached its conclusion in 2024, but its popularity has only increased since then. The anime still has to wrap up the Culling Game in Season 4 before moving on to the final arc of the story.
author: ComicBook

title: WEBTOON, Paramount Reveal 2 Star Trek Original Webcomic Series as Part of Partnership
content: WEBTOON Entertainment is teaming up with Paramount Products & Experiences to expand the Star Trek universe through two brand-new original webcomic series, Stargazers and Recollection . Both are set to debut exclusively on WEBTOON 's English-language platform.
author: ANN

title: Demon Slayer: The Hinokami Chronicles 2 Game Adds Doma on May 28
content: Sega announced on Monday in a new trailer for Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Hinokami Chronicles 2 , the sequel game to the 2021 Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Hinokami Chronicles game, that it will add Doma, the seventh and final DLC character for the "Infinity Castle Part 1 Character Pass," on May 28.
author: ANN

title: 22 Years On, Major Shonen Series’ Fans Still Await a Deserving Anime Adaptation
content: Atsushi Ohkubo is best known for creating the Soul Eater and the Fire Force manga, with both of them being set in the same world. While Soul Eater began serialization in June 2003, the first volume of the manga was released in Japan in June 2004.
author: ComicBook
